description: Source code implementing an array stack data structure with initialization, finalization, resizing, and push operations, used internally in Adobe's code for managing collections of items.

methods.name: cf2_arrstack_init
methods.description: Initializes an array stack structure with specified item size and memory context.

methods.name: cf2_arrstack_finalize
methods.description: Finalizes and frees resources associated with an array stack.

methods.name: cf2_arrstack_setNumElements
methods.description: Allocates or reallocates the buffer to hold a specified number of elements.

methods.name: cf2_arrstack_setCount
methods.description: Sets the current number of elements, expanding allocation if necessary.

methods.name: cf2_arrstack_clear
methods.description: Clears the stack's element count without freeing memory.

methods.name: cf2_arrstack_size
methods.description: Returns the current number of elements in the stack.

methods.name: cf2_arrstack_getBuffer
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the internal buffer.

methods.name: cf2_arrstack_getPointer
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the element at a given index, with bounds checking.

methods.name: cf2_arrstack_push
methods.description: Appends a new element to the end of the stack, resizing if needed.
